accent.job: The armed tool and the one primary action; it always touches ink and never touches the page.

light.note: The shipped light is the Library aura (LibraryView .aura): four lobes of the mark's mint, lime and yellow, dark peaks .17 / .15 / .05 / .10 on an eleven-stop bell, no animation. Here as three sources under one cap of .16; the faintest lobe (yellow, .05) is left out to keep to three. The WebGL aurora of ADR-0025 is not in the build yet; its arrival event is the one change the embassy plays. Tertiary ink (n9 #91949a) is not listed: over its light Recto steps quiet text up a level (tokens.css §1, text on glass), and n9 falls to 4.1:1 at the arrival's peak, so the embassy's quiet text is n10.
